about:
N.W. Metal Fabricators, Inc. has operated from Hermiston, Oregon, since 1986. The company serves customers throughout Umatilla County, including Hinkle and Charleston, providing custom metal fabrication and machining services.

The shop specializes in steel fabrication, arc welding, and precision machining. Its team of fabricators and welders produces handcrafted components built to exact customer specifications, handling projects that range from structural steelwork to machined parts.

The company works with businesses across the Hermiston region, delivering fabricated and machined parts for industrial, agricultural, and construction applications. While specific industry sectors are not detailed, its local customer base relies on the shop for custom metalwork and repair services.

N.W. Metal Fabricators emphasizes its combined workforce experience of over 100 years in professional fabrication, positioning that depth of knowledge as a key differentiator. The company states that its products are handcrafted to meet exact specifications, reflecting a focus on precision and craftsmanship.
